format.quoting: RFC 4180 for diagnostic files; indicator files contain numeric fields only

semantic_contract.observed: empirical observation or empty when no direct observation exists
semantic_contract.hybrid_2026: central BAU Hybrid 2026 reconstruction and conditional continuation
semantic_contract.forecast_median: legacy alias retained for audit compatibility; not read by the UI
semantic_contract.p10: pointwise 10th percentile of the admitted sensitivity ensemble
semantic_contract.p90: pointwise 90th percentile of the admitted sensitivity ensemble
